content:
**Wasteland Whisperer** is a perk in *Fallout 76*.

Increasing chance per rank to pacify creatures.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Aim your gun at some creatures for a 75% chance to pacify it. | 003A4A57 | 
| ★★ | 2 | Aim your gun at some creatures for a 50% chance to pacify it. | 003A4A56 | 
| ★ | 1 | Aim your gun at some creatures for a 25% chance to pacify it. | 003A4A55 | 

The perk works similarly to its appearance in *Fallout 4*; aim a ranged weapon at a wasteland creature and press the interact button to have a chance to pacify the creature. Each level of the perk increases the chance to pacify and the pacification effect lasts for 60 seconds. Once an attempt to pacify is made, another is possible after waiting 60 seconds. Pacified creatures cannot be given orders, instead performing their normal idle actions.

The following variants or related creatures cannot be pacified.
